comment: Recalibrated 2026-07-14 to official F1 19-corner numbering. Spline anchors from this track's own stock fast_lane.ai geometric curvature scan (local radius minima). Key anchor: Grand Hotel Hairpin apex s=0.380 (global-min radius 10.8 m), independently confirmed by the r6 race jam clustering at spline 0.364-0.385. Prior (2026-07-09) config buried the hairpin inside a '5-6 Mirabeau/Hairpin' 0.327-0.449 block and mislabelled the tunnel as 'Portier' at 0.494-0.545 - both fixed. Tight chicane/pool corners grouped where a single curvature min covers several. Name pass 2026-08-04 (D1-D5): 4 Casino Square, 19 Antony Noghes (spelling); per F1's official numbering 17 is the unnamed pool-exit bend and 18 La Rascasse - kept merged here as one bowl.
